title: List Of Foreign Census In The Central District

page_data.en:
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
SP. BR. REGISTRY
No. N.1437-F3-(1)
Date. 12 / 10 / 42

FOREIGN PAO CHIA AFFAIRS.

At 11.30 a.m. October 8th, 1942 the following
three members of the Executive Committee of the
Shanghai Jewish Chamber of Commerce came to Police
Headquarters and requested D.S.L. Sigerson to be
introduced to Supt. Yamaguchi, Officer i/c Foreign
Affairs Section;

L.Jodelfin - Chairman of the Jewish Chamber of
Commerce
L.N.Rogovin- Vice-Chairman;
B.Langotsky- Secretary;

After being introduced, L.N.Rogovin addressed Supt.
Yamaguchi stating that members of the Jewish Chamber
of Commerce in Shanghai have decided to contribute
the sum of $ 5,000.00 for the purpose of obtaining
the necessary equipment for the Jewish Refugee
Section of the Foreign Pao Chia, North of Suzhou
Creek and handed over a cheque for the above sum.

The cheque was received and immediately, in the
presence of the three above mentioned persons, handed
over to Mr Felix Kaufmann, Head of the Foreign Paо
Chia ( Jewish Section ) who issued to them a receipt
for the above sum.

Mr. Rogovin stated that he will keep the Chamber
of Commerce in a letter which will be forwarded at
earliest opportunity.

（批：Supt.
memorandum
for information
147）

（印：FILE）
page_data.zh:
上海公共租界工部局警务处
特务科登记室
编号 N.1437-F3-(1)
日期：1942年10月12日

外籍保甲事务。

1942年10月8日上午11时30分，上海犹太商会执行委员会的以下三名成员来到警察总局，请求将 D.S.L. Sigerson 介绍给负责外事科的山口警司（Supt. Yamaguchi）；

L. Jodelfin - 犹太商会主席
L. N. Rogovin - 副主席；
B. Langotsky - 秘书；

经介绍后，L. N. Rogovin 向山口警司表示，上海犹太商会成员已决定捐款 5,000.00 元，用于为苏州河北岸的外籍保甲犹太难民区购置必要设备，并递交了一张上述金额的支票。

该支票已被收下，并立即在上述三人在场的情况下，转交给外籍保甲（犹太区）主任 Felix Kaufmann 先生，后者向他们出具了收到上述款项的收据。

Rogovin 先生表示，他将致函商会说明此事，该信函将尽早发出。

（批注：供警司阅知的备忘录 147）

（印章：归档）
